scenarios.name: Standard Sales Order Processing (Happy Path)
scenarios.trigger: SOAP request received matching {{Glovia_Route_SalesOrder}} condition (OrderTypeCode = YORB)
scenarios.expected_outcome: Message routed through CallActivity_102 (Mapping) and CallActivity_13 (Generic Headers Logging) terminating at EndEvent_2 with HTTP 202/200 OK acknowledgement.
scenarios.validates: Routing condition SequenceFlow_82, payload transformation mapping, custom header enrichment, and successful message termination.

scenarios.name: Sales Order Return Processing (Alternative Happy Path)
scenarios.trigger: SOAP request received matching {{Glovia_Route2_ReturnSalesOrder}} condition (OrderTypeCode = POR)
scenarios.expected_outcome: Message routed via SequenceFlow_113 to CallActivity_71 (Generic Headers) without mapping, completing at EndEvent_9.
scenarios.validates: Routing condition SequenceFlow_113, header propagation, bypass of MessageMapping_1, and clean delivery to SO Return endpoint.

scenarios.name: Unmatched Routing Condition - Escalation End Event
scenarios.trigger: SOAP request with OrderTypeCode not meeting SalesOrder or ReturnSalesOrder predicates (e.g., UNKNOWN_TYPE)
scenarios.expected_outcome: Router defaults to SequenceFlow_110, triggering Escalation End Event (EndEvent_11) with ErrorCode 'RoutingConditionNotMet'.
scenarios.validates: Exclusive gateway default path routing and escalation event generation without silent message loss.

scenarios.name: Malformed XML Inbound - Exception Subprocess Activation
scenarios.trigger: Non-well-formed XML SOAP Envelope posted to /Glovia_SalesOrder endpoint
scenarios.expected_outcome: Message parsing failure triggers SubProcess_91, restores original payload via CallActivity_97, executes Log_Payload (1).gsh, and terminates with EndEvent_95 (Error End).
scenarios.validates: Exception subprocess capture, original payload restoration from exchange property 'InputPayload', and error logging script execution.

scenarios.name: Mapping Transformation Failure Handling
scenarios.trigger: Well-formed SOAP message matching SalesOrder route but missing mandatory target mapping fields (e.g. invalid date formats)
scenarios.expected_outcome: Message Mapping step CallActivity_102 raises a mapping exception, routing control to SubProcess_91, capturing InputPayload property and failing via EndEvent_95.
scenarios.validates: Message mapping resilience and failure recovery delegation to exception subprocess.

scenarios.name: Boundary & Whitespace OrderTypeCode Handling
scenarios.trigger: SOAP envelope with order code containing trailing spaces and boundary code 'PLM '
scenarios.expected_outcome: Evaluator normalizes or strictly routes depending on configured externalized parameters; tests defensive trimming.
scenarios.validates: Condition evaluation robustness against un-sanitized sender payload values.

risks.risk: Message Loss via Unhandled Gateway Conditions
risks.consequence: Messages not matching predefined SalesOrder or ReturnSalesOrder predicates reach EscalationEndEvent (EndEvent_11) with 'RoutingConditionNotMet'. If no parent monitoring alerts on Escalation, orders remain unfulfilled.
risks.mitigation: Unit tests assert that default route SequenceFlow_110 explicitly sets escalation error codes and returns unambiguous status codes (422) for DLQ / retry queue ingestion.

risks.risk: Payload Loss during Exception Subprocess Handling
risks.consequence: CallActivity_97 overwrites the exchange body using '${property.InputPayload}'. If CallActivity_4 fails before property initialization, the logged body will be null, obscuring diagnostic audit trails.
risks.mitigation: Test case TC_GLOVIA_04 verifies that exchange property 'InputPayload' retains the original incoming body string prior to error handling and script logging.

risks.risk: Orphaned Processing Steps and Dead Code
risks.consequence: CallActivity_77 (Groovy script GLOVIA_Conditioncheck_Salesorder_Create.groovy) and CallActivity_86 are defined in BPMN but have no incoming sequence flows, indicating incomplete refactoring or dead code paths.
risks.mitigation: Document unlinked flow steps in coverage analysis and verify runtime routing purely relies on gateway XPath conditions rather than orphaned Groovy steps.

risks.risk: Namespace Handling Failure in XML Evaluation
risks.consequence: XmlSlurper logic vs BPMN XPath expressions discrepancies: Salesforce Outbound Message namespaces ('http://soap.sforce.com/2005/09/outbound') can cause XPath mismatch if prefix bindings vary.
risks.mitigation: Payload test suites explicitly define ns1 and ns2 declarations to validate strict namespace-aware evaluation.

uncovered_paths: CallActivity_77 (GLOVIA_Conditioncheck_Salesorder_Create.groovy) and CallActivity_86 (Content Modifier) are completely disconnected from all BPMN SequenceFlow elements in the process definition, rendering them unreachable in the active runtime graph.
coverage_recommendations: Connect CallActivity_86 and CallActivity_77 between ParallelGateway_74 and ExclusiveGateway_80 if condition validation script is intended to be executed before routing.

If CallActivity_77 was superseded by gateway XPath conditions, formally remove CallActivity_77 and CallActivity_86 from the BPMN definitions to eliminate technical debt and attain 100% executable model coverage.
